GenAiFunction.description: Invoke this action when a customer expresses frustration due to repeated issues or unsatisfactory responses during the conversation. Before invoking, the agent must acknowledge the customer's concern, apologize for the inconvenience, and ask whether they would like a support case to be created. This action should only be triggered after the customer explicitly confirms their request. Once confirmed, the agent invokes this action to successfully create a support case on the customer's behalf.
